name: jev
description: v0.1.0: advisory-only wrapper for jev (TypeSafe AI's "System One" model), which returns typed, calibrated decisions — Noul (probability), Choice (option + distribution), Score (rubric) — instead of text. NOT subscription-native: jev is a metered third-party cloud API ($0.042/M input tokens, measured 2026-10-02), so this plugin is INERT BY DEFAULT and does nothing at all without TYPESAFE_API_KEY exported. Two properties are enforced by types rather than promised: (1) the answer type has no "clean" variant, so jev can never clear anything and "jev approved" is indistinguishable from "jev never ran" — which is what makes a missing key a structural no-op rather than a documented intention; (2) no coupling to harness_core::verdict::Verdict in either direction, so an external service structurally cannot hold block/allow authority (CLAUDE.md section 7). With no key the client performs ZERO network calls, pinned by counting transport invocations across four environments (unset / empty / non-UTF-8 / present) and observed RED before GREEN. The credential is read from the environment only (never a flag) and travels to curl through a stdin config, never argv, so it is not visible in ps. Every call is appended to a local usage ledger recording tokens, model and latency — never the evaluated state. Manual: one bundled Rust binary (check / ask / ledger), no hooks.
